texts.facts: 5. This is an application filed under Section 528 of the B.N.S.S. for quashing the impugned cogninzance order dated 07.09.2024 passed by the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Firozabad and further to quash the entire proceedings of case no 78256/2024 (State vs/ Brijesh Upadhayaya), under Section 11 of the Uttar Pradesh Fire Prevention and Fire Safety Act, 2005, Police Station Tundla, District Firozabad, pending in the Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Friozabad. , however, no reply was submitted, thus offence under Section 11 of the U.P. Fire Prevention and Fire Safety Act, 2005 came to be made out and a complaint in this regard was filed before Chief Judicial Magistrate, Firozabad, in which, case was registered as complaint case no. 78256 of 2024, in which, on 07.09.2024, summoning order came to be passed. 7.
texts.arguments: 6. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that a complaint was lodged on 05.03.2024 by opposite party no. 2-Chief Fire Officer, Firozabad against the applicant with an allegation that M/s Upadhyaya Cold Storage Pvt. Ltd. was served with departmental notice dated 17.10.2018 and two reminders dated 02.02.2021 and 19.02.2021 Questioning the summoning order dated 07.09.2024, summoning the applicant under Section 11 of the U.P. Fire Prevention and Fire Safety Act, 2005, the present application has been preferred. 8. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the summoning order cannot be sustained for more than one year, firstly, no offences are made out and secondly, the same is totally non-speaking, unreasonable and even it does not decide the case of the complainant, so as to, prima facie, satisfy the fact that the offences are made out. He seeks to rely upon the judgment of Hon'ble Apex Court in M/s J.M. Laboratories and Others vs State of Andhra Pradesh and Another, 2025 INSC 127. It is further submitted that no offences are made out as the applicant is not connected to the said offences. 9. Learned AGA, on the other hand, has submitted that from bare reading of the complaint and documents on record, prima facie, offences are made out, however, he could not dispute the fact that Brijesh Upadhyaya vs State Of U.P. And Another on 4 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/33403226/ 2 the summoning order has been passed without recording any reasoning and it is not as per the mandate of Hon'ble Apex Court in M/s J.M. Laboratories and Others (supra). He submits that the summoning order be set-aside and remitted back to court below to pass a fresh order.
